test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to improve it. If no improvement is required, select ‘No improvement required’.

I __would love fly__ a fighter jet one day.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase **"love fly**" is incorrect and needs to be corrected.
 
• The correct form should be "**love to fly" **as it correctly follows the verb pattern
 
 
• **"would love to" + base form of the verb**.
 
 
 
• The correct substitution would be "**would love to fly".**

Hence, the correct statement is :** *I would love to fly a fighter jet one day*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When using expressions like "would love to" or "would like to", they should be followed by the base form of the verb.
 
• **Example:** ***I would like to visit Paris someday*.**
 
• This pattern ensures the sentence is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning clearly.
